# Vedic Homeopathic Clinic — Doctor OS

> A clinic operating system built around the doctor's workflow — live queue, consultation workspace, prescriptions, billing and follow-ups for homeopathic and allopathic clinics.

Vennova / Vedic Clinic is a multi-role SaaS for clinic operations. The owner registers the clinic, then issues credentials for reception, doctors, and admins. Patient data is scoped per clinic.

## Pages

- [Sign in / Register clinic](/auth): Owner registration and staff sign-in.
